steps: Service A makes a normal local outbound call.
Its proxy applies identity, telemetry, and traffic policy.
Control-plane configuration tells both proxies how to trust and route.
Peer proxy authenticates the channel and delivers to Service B.

lesson.scenario: Order and fraud workloads gain uniform mTLS, retries, and telemetry through colocated proxies without trusting the pod network.
